claims.statement: The circular calls intermediaries who distribute SFC-authorised funds 'distributors'.

claims.action: Offer gifts to a client in promoting an investment product
conditions: Promotion of a specific investment product or a particular type of investment product to a client

evidence.quote: Paragraph 3.11 of the Code of Conduct provides that distributors should not offer any gifts (other than a discount of fees or charges) in promoting a specific investment product or a particular type of investment product to a client.

exceptions: A discount of fees or charges
claims.statement: Distributors should not offer gifts when promoting a specific investment product or a particular type of investment product to a client, subject to the fee or charge discount exception.
temporal: In promoting the product or product type

claims.action: Exclude a discount of fees or charges from the gift restriction
conditions: The offered benefit is a discount of fees or charges

evidence.quote: any gifts (other than a discount of fees or charges)

claims.statement: A discount of fees or charges is excepted from the stated gift restriction.
uncertainty: The supplied text does not define which benefits qualify as a discount of fees or charges; the exception does not establish compliance with other requirements.

claims.action: Apply the gift requirement to gifts linked to a product type
conditions: Gifts are offered in a way that links them to a particular type of investment product

evidence.quote: If gifts are offered in such a way that they are linked to a particular type of investment product, such as certain types of funds or funds offered by certain fund houses, then such gifts will be bound by this requirement

exceptions: The fee or charge discount exception in c3
claims.statement: The gift requirement covers gifts linked to a particular product type, including certain types of funds or funds offered by certain fund houses.
uncertainty: The examples do not provide an exhaustive test for determining a product-type connection.

claims.action: Avoid distracting investors from product features and risks through gifts

evidence.quote: The purpose of the requirement is to avoid the use of gifts to distract investors from the features and risks of a particular product.

claims.statement: The stated purpose is to avoid gifts distracting investors from a product's features and risks.
uncertainty: The purpose statement does not expressly make proof of actual distraction a condition of the restriction.

claims.action: Have regard to paragraph 3.11 when offering guaranteed returns or other incentives
conditions: Offering guaranteed returns or other incentives in promoting SFC-authorised funds

evidence.quote: Even where the guaranteed returns offered would not constitute a “structured product” under the SFO, distributors are reminded to have regard to paragraph 3.11 of the Code of Conduct in offering such returns or other incentives in promoting SFC-authorised funds

claims.statement: Paragraph 3.11 remains relevant to promotional guaranteed returns and other incentives even where the guaranteed returns would not constitute a structured product under the SFO.
temporal: When offering the returns or incentives in promoting funds

claims.action: Classify guaranteed returns or other promotional incentives as gifts
conditions: Returns or other incentives are offered in promoting SFC-authorised funds

evidence.quote: as they may be considered a gift that should not be offered to investors.

claims.statement: Such returns or incentives may be considered a gift that should not be offered to investors.
uncertainty: 'May be considered' expresses possible classification, not permission or a determination that every incentive is a gift.

claims.action: Offer additional returns or other incentives in breach of the cited requirements
conditions: The offer breaches section 103 of the SFO or paragraph 3.11 of the Code of Conduct

evidence.quote: when offering or promoting funds, distributors should not offer additional returns (which are not part of the product features set out in the relevant offering documents) or other incentives to investors in breach of section 103 of the SFO or paragraph 3.11 of the Code of Conduct.

claims.statement: When offering or promoting funds, distributors should not offer returns additional to the documented product features or other incentives in breach of section 103 or paragraph 3.11.
uncertainty: This is conditioned on breach of the cited requirements; it does not establish an unconditional ban on all additional returns or incentives.

claims.action: Identify the Code of Conduct referenced by the control

evidence.quote: The Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (Code of Conduct).

claims.statement: The referenced Code is the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission.

claims.action: Refer to the FAQ supporting the product-type connection

evidence.quote: The answer to question 1 of the frequently asked questions on the Code of Conduct issued by the SFC on 30 September 2010.

claims.statement: Footnote 3 identifies answer 1 of the SFC's Code of Conduct FAQs issued on 30 September 2010 as supporting authority.
temporal: 30 September 2010 is the cited FAQ issuance date
uncertainty: The FAQ text is not supplied; its issuance date is not stated to be the control's effective date.

uncertainties: The full paragraph 3.11 and cited FAQ answer are not supplied, so additional definitions, qualifications or exceptions cannot be resolved from this packet.

The circular concerns SFC-authorised funds, while its quotation of paragraph 3.11 refers more broadly to investment products. The full reach beyond the circular's setting requires the underlying Code.
No effective date, transition period or compliance deadline for the selected control is supplied.
The packet does not conclusively define gifts, fee or charge discounts, or the degree of connection needed to link a gift to a product type.

units.rationale: Defines distributors and supplies the circular's fund-distribution setting and concern about distracting incentives.
Background heading only.
Observed additional features and restrictions explain the setting; they do not independently define gifts.
Standing-instruction investment services are background to separate marketing provisions, not a gift exception.
Describes public marketing practices without limiting the selected client-promotion control to public campaigns.
Guaranteed-returns section heading.
Identifies the parallel statutory authority recorded as a3.
Explains typical fund-return and distributor top-up components; it does not classify every such arrangement as a gift.
Conditional possible structured-product classification concerns a parallel statutory regime; c6 preserves independence of the gift control.
Section 103 offence and authorisation or exemption qualifications concern public structured-product invitations, not exceptions to paragraph 3.11.
Offering-document disclosure requirements and potential misleading attribution explain concern about distributor guarantees; they do not determine gift status.
Heading identifies the selected control's underlying authority a1.
Preserves application beyond structured products and uncertainty in gift classification.
Contains the selected restriction, discount exception, product connection and rationale.
Connects additional returns and incentives to breach of the separate statutory or Code requirements.
Heading introduces separate redemption and dealing controls.
Observed lock-ups and reduced dealing frequency do not qualify the gift restriction.
Fairness and redemption-right provisions are separate controls; authority recorded as a5.
Administrative dealing procedures and best-endeavours expectations concern dealing frequency, not permissible gifts.
Heading for separate marketing issues.
Separate misleading-advertising provision preserves a should expectation and must compliance requirement; it supplies no gift exception. Authority recorded as a6.
Conditional advertising-guideline expectation for presentation of underlying fund returns is separate from gifts; authority recorded as a7.
Separate advertising expectations address misleading risk-free returns and deposit comparisons, without changing gift scope.
Monitoring and possible regulatory action or guidance provide enforcement context, not a control commencement date.
Issuing department and division attribution.
Institutional attribution.
Commission attribution.
Footnote 1 supports separate offering-document disclosure duties; authority recorded as a4.
Footnote 2 identifies the Code governing the selected control.
Footnote 3 supplies the interpretive dependency for linked gifts, with an authority issuance date.
Footnote 4 identifies evolving supplements to the separate advertising guidelines; dependency recorded as a8.
